tasks.title: Reconcile canonical Git history and create foundation branch
tasks.acceptance: Branch starts at origin/main without force-push; local main remains untouched.

tasks.title: Repair source contradictions and record ADR-001 through ADR-008
tasks.acceptance: Blocker and major decisions are consistent across canonical documents and ADRs.

tasks.title: Add executable requirements and task traceability
tasks.acceptance: Every MVP FR has an owner, phase, task, contract, test placeholder, and release gate.

tasks.title: Scaffold Go, Python 3.12, React Vite, contracts, and local development
tasks.acceptance: All language scaffolds compile and their smoke tests pass without product behavior.

tasks.title: Add documentation, task, contract, license, and traceability validation
tasks.acceptance: Invalid local links, task IDs, contract invariants, licenses, and traceability entries fail verification.

tasks.title: Add CI, dependency scanning, secret scanning, and changed-line coverage policy
tasks.acceptance: A clean pull request runs make verify, gitleaks, and dependency review.

tasks.title: Implement FR-103a event-only vehicle activity
tasks.acceptance: Confirmed camera-local vehicle tracks produce deterministic, bounded vehicle_activity events with detected behavior, a canonical shared-detector class, model provenance, and pending human-review state; AI and platform validation exclude LPR, ReID, speed, identity, risk scoring, and theft claims.

tasks.title: Implement abandoned-object temporal logic and evaluation
tasks.acceptance: Camera-local track-separation and configurable 30--60 second dwell rules emit deterministic, review-required abandoned-object alerts; synthetic temporal evaluation passes and production promotion remains gated on held-out per-zone evaluation.

tasks.title: Approve public source publication policy
tasks.acceptance: Owner authorized temporary public implementation publication without an open-source license on 2026-08-12. Default copyright applies and no LICENSE file is added. Legal review and the final public/private policy remain outstanding before GA.

tasks.title: Implement provider-neutral OIDC token verification boundary
tasks.acceptance: Signed tokens require exact issuer, audience, expiry, subject, tenant, role, and canonical authorization claims; invalid tokens fail closed.

tasks.title: Implement five seed roles and deny-by-default authorization
tasks.acceptance: Role grant, explicit scope, MFA, tenant, and site checks are server-enforced with negative tests.

tasks.title: Expose tenant-safe current-user and site read APIs
tasks.acceptance: Authenticated users can read their own context and visible sites; cross-tenant and cross-site rows are never returned.

tasks.title: Add tenant and site Postgres migrations with row-level security
tasks.acceptance: Tenant, site, idempotency, and audit tables migrate idempotently; the non-superuser application role fails closed without a verified transaction-local tenant and cannot read another tenant.

tasks.title: Implement idempotent audited site creation
tasks.acceptance: POST /v1/sites requires tenant-manager authorization, UUIDv4 correlation, and a tenant-scoped idempotency key; product state, replay response, and append-only hash-chained audit event commit atomically.

tasks.title: Add tenant event and transactional outbox persistence
tasks.acceptance: Event and outbox tables migrate idempotently, enforce transaction-local tenant RLS, and fail closed for the non-superuser application role.

tasks.title: Implement authenticated idempotent event ingestion
tasks.acceptance: POST /v1/events validates the canonical event contract and site scope; one event, outbox message, and audit record commit atomically, while duplicate delivery produces one logical event.

tasks.title: Implement leased local outbox dispatch
tasks.acceptance: A tenant-scoped worker leases unpublished messages with SKIP LOCKED, records attempts, releases failed leases, and marks only successfully published messages complete.

tasks.title: Project events idempotently into the alert queue
tasks.acceptance: Each accepted event produces at most one tenant- and site-scoped alert and consumer receipt; GET /v1/alerts returns only authorized queue rows in priority order.

tasks.title: Connect Alert Center to audited REST and resumable realtime alerts
tasks.acceptance: The React Alert Center validates v1 alert envelopes, lists the tenant queue, acknowledges with idempotency and correlation headers, consumes site-ticketed WebSocket snapshots and events, resumes from the last sequence after reconnect, resyncs on gaps, and retains an explicit credential-free demo mode.

tasks.title: Build an alert-derived operations dashboard foundation
tasks.acceptance: The responsive operations dashboard derives queue KPIs, module and severity distributions, and incident drill-downs from the tenant-scoped alert feed; labels every synthetic or unavailable analytics and camera-health value; and exposes chart data in accessible tables.

tasks.title: Build a privacy-safe Camera Wall foundation
tasks.acceptance: The responsive Camera Wall provides searchable and filterable camera metadata, 1/4/9/16/25 layouts, keyboard tile navigation, alert-linked spotlight and queue views, synthetic-only demo scenes, and an explicit unavailable state until tenant-scoped audited streaming APIs exist.

tasks.title: Implement the tenant-scoped camera registry foundation
tasks.acceptance: Camera CRUD enforces tenant and site authorization, transaction-local RLS, per-tenant serial uniqueness, optimistic configuration versions, allowed lifecycle transitions, idempotent creation, soft retirement, and atomic append-only auditing; Camera Wall validates and renders metadata-only live inventory without exposing credentials or footage.

tasks.title: Implement one-time edge-device claim and activation
tasks.acceptance: An authorized administrator issues an idempotent 24-hour device claim whose bearer token is never persisted in plaintext; activation validates the signed tenant and serial, atomically consumes the token once, binds the edge device to its tenant and site under RLS, and appends audit records without secrets.

tasks.title: Implement certificate-authenticated device heartbeat and fleet status
tasks.acceptance: An active registry device submits bounded idempotent telemetry only when its verified client-certificate UUID matches the route; tenant/site-scoped fleet reads derive offline after the canonical 90-second heartbeat age, and RLS plus the guarded heartbeat function prevent cross-tenant table access.

tasks.title: Connect the Go edge agent to certificate-authenticated heartbeat transport
tasks.acceptance: The edge agent sends bounded telemetry over a caller-configured TLS 1.3/mTLS client to the documented heartbeat route, generates correlation and heartbeat UUIDv4 values, preserves replay identity, rejects malformed responses, and schedules attempts no slower than the canonical 30-second interval without tenant or user credentials.

tasks.title: Add supervised FFmpeg RTSP ingest transport
tasks.acceptance: The Go edge agent validates RTSP/RTSPS camera sources, starts a TCP-by-default FFmpeg pull with bounded connection timeouts, reports credential-safe lifecycle state, and restarts unexpected exits with bounded exponential backoff; fake-runner tests cover command construction, cancellation, retries, and secret-safe errors.

tasks.title: Add codec-aware H.264 and H.265 decode selection
tasks.acceptance: The edge RTSP supervisor selects normalized H.264/H.265 FFmpeg decoders, prefers allowlisted Jetson or CUDA hardware paths in auto mode, falls back deterministically to software, fails closed for unavailable forced hardware, and reports only credential-safe codec capability state.

tasks.title: Add durable bounded edge store-and-forward spool
tasks.acceptance: Opaque payloads persist atomically across restart with integrity verification; replay prioritizes metadata, evidence, then archive video and removes items only after acknowledgement; quota pressure evicts the globally oldest item first; queue depth, bytes, oldest age, enqueue, acknowledgement, and eviction metrics are available for telemetry.

tasks.title: Extend edge heartbeat with bounded health telemetry
tasks.acceptance: The edge health monitor reports bounded CPU, GPU, temperature, and inference-latency samples no slower than every 30 seconds, derives thermal warnings at canonical thresholds, and transports optional backward-compatible health through the certificate-authenticated heartbeat into tenant-scoped persisted fleet status.

tasks.title: Implement Phase 3 zone registry and rule-builder foundation
tasks.acceptance: Tenant/site-scoped GeoJSON intrusion, restricted-zone, loitering, abandoned-object, and tripwire configuration has versioned, idempotent, audited REST persistence under RLS; the responsive console exposes a clearly synthetic rule-builder workspace without claiming live footage, edge push, simulation, or mask-zone dual approval.

tasks.title: Deliver versioned zone configuration to edge devices
tasks.acceptance: Publishing an authorized zone creates an immutable tenant/site revision under RLS and audit; mTLS edge clients receive heartbeat revision hints, pull only newer snapshots, apply them atomically, retain the last known-good revision after any apply failure, and report applied or failed status without leaking credentials or pixels. Privacy mask zones remain excluded pending their separate security-reviewed dual-approval slice.

tasks.title: Add deterministic camera-local zone-rule runtime foundation
tasks.acceptance: A bounded deterministic runtime evaluates enabled camera-bound intrusion, restricted-zone, loitering, and tripwire GeoJSON rules against timestamp-ordered local tracks; it emits retry-stable canonical human-review events without coordinates, track IDs, pixels, identities, embeddings, plate data, or cross-camera linkage. Malformed geometry and all privacy-mask configuration fail closed. Production release remains gated on tracker/detector integration, privacy validation, and hardware-in-loop testing.

tasks.title: Atomically activate verified zone configuration in the local rule runtime
tasks.acceptance: The local zone-rule runtime accepts only a strictly newer configuration revision already validated by the mTLS/hash/atomic-file edge path, compiles it before activation, rejects stale or malformed candidates, and preserves the last known-good in-memory runtime on failure. It emits no events until a valid rule configuration is active and continues to reject privacy-mask zones.

tasks.title: Add bounded camera-local tracker metadata sampling for zone rules
tasks.acceptance: A metadata-only local ingress accepts bounded timestamp-ordered batches of same-camera tracks at configured 5--10 FPS, suppresses excess samples deterministically, only passes sampled tracks to the active zone runtime, and reports safe counters. It carries no frames, pixels, credentials, identities, embeddings, or plates; it does not do detector inference or external event transport; and it fails closed on mixed-scope, duplicate, or out-of-order batches.

tasks.title: Add local tenant and device admission limits for sampled tracker metadata
tasks.acceptance: Sampled camera-local tracker batches require explicit bounded per-tenant/device frame and per-tenant track limits. The ingress admits or rejects a whole sampled batch deterministically, reports credential- and payload-free remaining-capacity pressure, resets the accounting at the next UTC second, and fails closed on invalid limits or timestamp regressions. No raw frames, detector inference, cloud quota service, network transport, or privacy-mask processing is added.

tasks.title: Deliver versioned bounded loitering dwell configuration
tasks.acceptance: Tenant/site-scoped loitering zones support an audited, idempotent, optimistic-versioned dwell duration from 30 through 600 seconds. The value is rejected for other zone kinds, persisted under RLS, included in immutable edge configuration snapshots, and validated by the camera-local runtime before activation. No detector, raw-frame, privacy-mask, or autonomous-action capability is added.

tasks.title: Deliver bounded subject-class gates for zone rules
tasks.acceptance: Tenant/site-scoped zone configuration supports an optional normalized allowlist of the seven canonical local subject classes. The field is idempotent, audited, optimistic-versioned, RLS-persisted, and delivered in immutable edge snapshots; unconfigured tracker classes do not update rule state or emit events. Unknown, duplicate, identity, biometric, plate, ReID, and animal classes fail closed, and no detector or raw-frame capability is added.

tasks.title: Bound camera-local zone runtime state
tasks.acceptance: The deterministic camera-local zone runtime caps rule-track state at 10,000 entries, evicts only state older than a 15-minute retention window, and rejects any observation that would exceed capacity before mutating state. The retention window never shortens the maximum 10-minute loiter duration; status exposes only aggregate counts. No frames, pixels, detector inference, identities, biometrics, plates, ReID, cross-camera linkage, or privacy-mask processing is added.

tasks.title: Canonicalize local zone observation classes
tasks.acceptance: Before a camera-local zone observation can update state or emit an event, its class must be one of person, bicycle, bus, car, motorcycle, truck, or van. Animal, identity, biometric, plate, embedding, ReID, unknown, and malformed labels fail closed. Empty rule allowlists continue to evaluate every permitted local class; no detector, frame, pixel, or external transport capability is added.

tasks.title: Reserve Super Admin privacy-mask approval capability
tasks.acceptance: The privacy_masks:approve capability is granted only to MFA-authenticated Super Admins. It is explicitly separate from ordinary configuration write and does not by itself create, approve, deliver, or activate any privacy mask. The subsequent dedicated workflow must add distinct dual approval, immutable auditing, pre-encode edge verification, and hardware-in-loop release evidence.

tasks.title: Add privacy-mask dual-approval workflow foundation
tasks.acceptance: MFA-authorized Super Admins can create metadata-only privacy-mask requests. The requester cannot approve; exactly two distinct Super Admin approvals are required before status becomes approved, and duplicates are idempotent. The request remains excluded from zones and edge delivery until the following immutable-audit and pre-encode verification slices.

tasks.title: Add immutable privacy-mask approval ledger schema
tasks.acceptance: Postgres stores tenant-RLS privacy-mask request metadata and immutable approval rows. Approval rows cannot be modified or deleted by the application role; only insert/select is granted. Generic zones and edge delivery continue to exclude privacy masks. The next repository slice must atomically append hash-chained audit events.

tasks.title: Atomically audit privacy-mask approval ledger transitions
tasks.acceptance: Production privacy-mask request creation and each distinct approval use tenant-scoped Postgres transactions that write the governed state and an append-only hash-chained audit event together. Requesters cannot approve, exactly two distinct Super Admin approvals are required, duplicate approvals remain idempotent, and all failures roll back. Privacy masks remain excluded from generic zones and edge delivery pending pre-encode verification and hardware-in-loop release evidence.

tasks.title: Verify privacy-mask plans before edge encoding
tasks.acceptance: A bounded camera-local verifier accepts only metadata for a UUID-scoped request with exactly two distinct non-requester approvers, normalized closed Polygon geometry, and the strict decode-mask-encode pipeline order. It emits deterministic metadata-only verification evidence and fails closed on any mismatch. It neither receives pixels nor activates or delivers masks; hardware-in-loop proof of actual pre-encode enforcement remains required.

tasks.title: Verify signed physical HIL evidence for privacy-mask release
tasks.acceptance: A release-evidence boundary accepts only a signed attestation from an allowlisted physical camera/encoder HIL harness for a verified pre-encode candidate hash. It requires masking-before-encoding, denied encoder bypass, no raw-frame retention, UUID-scoped device/test identities, and opaque SHA-256 build/probe hashes; it rejects simulation, malformed, tampered, or untrusted evidence. This code does not fabricate physical test results, activate masks, or deliver them to edge devices.

tasks.title: Gate controlled privacy-mask release at the edge
tasks.acceptance: A separate privacy-only edge controller accepts a strictly newer release manifest only when UUID-scoped device metadata, strict pre-encode verification, and signed allowlisted physical HIL evidence agree on the same candidate hash. It invokes a metadata-only atomic release-slot applier, preserves the prior accepted release after stale, verification, or apply failure, and reports only safe accepted/failed status. Generic zone delivery, frames, pixels, encoder execution, and a platform transport are excluded.

tasks.title: Add durable privacy-mask release delivery schema
tasks.acceptance: Postgres stores tenant-RLS privacy-only release manifests and the latest safe per-device release status. Release manifests are immutable and versioned per tenant/device; the application role cannot delete release or status records. Generic zone/configuration delivery continues to exclude masks. The following repository/transport must authorize releases against an approved request plus verified HIL evidence and append audit events atomically.
